source.producer: easyeda pcb dump (REAL snapshot, 2 copper layer(s)); reference pour arcs discretised <=0.05 mil chord error; only L1 tracks modelled

scope.statement: Offline geometric/topological review of high-speed signal reference planes and return-path candidates for the declared snapshot only. This is NOT a DRC, NOT an impedance/EMI/eye-diagram or full SI simulation, NOT proof of electrical connection, and NOT manufacturing or functional approval.
checks: E3 layer transitions and return candidates
not_claimed: SI/EMI/EMC, crosstalk, eye diagram, timing or certification
electrical continuity of copper or of any return structure
DRC/DFM clearance, Gerber correctness or board-house acceptance
differential skew or length tuning (out of scope here)
any PCB modification: this tool never edits the design
scope.interface: real EasyEDA dump replay (reference pour continuity)

evidence_sources.title: SLLA414 — High-Speed Interface Layout Guidelines (high-speed differential, via, return path, ESD sections as recorded in project reference G06)
evidence_sources.revision: SLLA414 (revision not re-verified in this run)
evidence_sources.verification: V2/V3: URL resolves (HTTP 200, application/pdf); PDF body and page numbers not machine-readable here; already cited by the project reference register (design-experience.md G06).
evidence_sources.conditions: Applies to the interfaces/data rates the document itself covers; qualitative layout guidance only, not a universal numeric standard.

evidence_sources.revision: UG583 (page reachable; revision text not extractable here)
evidence_sources.verification: V2: URL resolves (HTTP 200) but the page is a JS document viewer; body not extractable in this environment.
evidence_sources.conditions: UltraScale devices/interfaces only; not automatically applicable to other devices or interfaces.

evidence_sources.title: IPC-2221 — Generic Standard on Printed Board Design (standard family; exact revision letter not re-verified)
evidence_sources.revision: paywalled; revision not verified in this run
evidence_sources.verification: V0: paid standard, body not accessed. Cited only as the industry design-standard entry point; no threshold is taken from it.
evidence_sources.conditions: Background reference only; never used for any numeric threshold.

limits: Only straight segments, circular vias and simple polygonal copper (with holes) are supported in v1.
Arcs, curved copper, thermal-relief spoke geometry and native pour results are not modelled; declared unsupported objects stay unknown.
Copper geometry is the projected same-XY footprint; layer-to-layer registration error is covered only by board.geometry_tolerance.
No electrical simulation or measurement was performed.
